about.title: About Mirna
about.headline: Thoughtfully chosen, simply delivered
about.lead: Mirna is an online store for pieces we would choose for ourselves: carefully selected, clearly presented and easy to order.
about.storyBody1: We believe shopping online should feel as considered as browsing a favourite boutique. Every product in our collection is chosen for its quality, its details and the way it fits into everyday life.
about.storyBody2: We keep the experience calm and clear: honest product information, prices in your own currency, and a store that works as naturally in Arabic as it does in English.

curated.title: A curated selection
curated.body: Fewer, better pieces, chosen with care and refreshed with new arrivals.
